description: A plan's name (its tier), free trial, devices or per seat. Only what is sent changes. The price never changes: a new price is a new plan (toolaby_add_plan), and the old one is retired (toolaby_retire_plan).

plan.description: A plan id, as toolaby_get_tool lists them (the first plan is "default").

tool.description: The tool id, as toolaby_list_tools gives it (like "acme--word-counter"); the short one ("word-counter") works when it names one tool.

name: toolaby_update_plan
title: Change a plan's terms
